discription: A warm, evolving pulse wave pad sound with slight width modulation and a resonant low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, pan=0; var sig, env, lfo; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.5, 2.0, 0.7, 3.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); lfo = SinOsc.kr(0.2).range(0.1, 0.9); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, lfo); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq * 2, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
